title: Fortutide — Internal Recruiting Platform
goal: Streamline requisition→pipeline→offer and increase recruiter effectiveness.
summary: Journey mapping for recruiter, hiring manager, and candidate; stage definitions; interview scheduling; decision support cues.

sections.title: What I Led
sections.body: • Client acquisition and scope; project/product management; budget and milestones.\n• Service design; user interviews/testing; design systems; dev handoff and QA.

sections.title: Outcomes
sections.body: Shorter cycle time from requisition to decision, clearer stage ownership, better recruiter↔hiring manager collaboration.
